sarah: Heads-up — found a cluster of long-lived Vault leases (partner-signer namespace) that were renewed past their TTLs. Possible token reuse or an automation misconfig. Logs: https://internal/logs/issue/CL-4821. @ajay @taylor can you triage?

ajay: On it. Do we have an example lease id and the service account that used it? severity?

sarah: example lease: lease_2026_04_17_9a7b. Impact: some partner ingesters still have access to secrets they should have lost. Treat as high since it touches partner creds.

taylor: I propose we follow the KMS-lease-revocation playbook draft — quick containment steps: freeze issuer, revoke affected leases, rotate wrapping key versions, rewrap ciphertext with new version, and block the offending SA via RBAC while we rebuild credentials. I'll paste commands.

kevin: Standby to run revocations. If we revoke leases we need a planned restart window for consumers. Where's the list of consumers?

ajay: Pulling consumers from telemetry and vault-audit. Quick grep gave 24 distinct service principals referencing that lease prefix. I'll hand the list to kevin.

sec-bot: Incident created: #incident-kms-lease-2026-04-17. PagerDuty alert sent to sec-oncall.

sarah: OK action plan: 1) kevin — revoke leases and monitor consumer errors (ETA 15m) 2) ajay — run KMS rewrap for ciphertexts and rotate key version (ETA 30m) 3) taylor — apply temporary RBAC deny on implicated SA and enable verbose audit logging for vault/kms (ETA 10m) 4) I'll coordinate partner notification and postmortem.

kevin: Starting revoke now. Command I'll run: ```
vault lease revoke -prefix=partner-signer/lease_2026_04_17
# then verify active leases:
vault list sys/leases/lookup
```

kevin: update: revoked ~120 leases so far, consumers started to 503 on some endpoints. I'm throttling to 50/min and rolling restarts of webhooks to reduce errors.

ajay: kicked off rewrap script. Using KMS key ring prod-wrap, key name: partner-wrap-key. Script snippet: ```
for blob in $(list-encrypted | grep partner-signer); do
  plaintext=$(gcloud kms decrypt --ciphertext-file="$blob")
  gcloud kms encrypt --key=projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/prod-wrap/cryptoKeys/partner-wrap-key --plaintext-file=- --ciphertext-file=${blob}.rewrap
  upload ${blob}.rewrap
done
```

ajay: rewrap at 40% (10/24). No integrity errors so far.

sec-bot: Vault audit enabled at debug level for namespace partner-signer. Audit stream: s3://redwood-audit/partner-signer/2026-04-17/

taylor: RBAC deny applied to service account partner-ingest-svcacc@redwood-prod. Terraform change queued: ```
resource "google_service_account_iam_binding" "deny_partner_ingest" {
  service_account_id = "partner-ingest-svcacc@redwood-prod"
  role               = "roles/iam.serviceAccountUser"
  members            = ["user:BLOCKED@redwood.com"]
}
```

taylor: Also flipped audit flag to include kms:keyVersionChange, vault:leaseRevoke events.

kevin: Revoke completed for the initial batch. Rolling restarts applied to 3 primary clusters, consumer error rate dropping. Collecting post-revoke failure logs now.

ajay: Rewrap complete for all listed blobs. Rotated key version from 3 -> 4 and set new version as primary. Pushed terraform change to rotate key version and added a manual approval step. Link: https://terraform/ui/runs/5678

kevin: Verified apps can decrypt rewrapped blobs with new key version after restart. No failures in the last 10m.

sarah: Nice work. Immediate containment status: REVOKES done, KMS rewrap + key rotation done, RBAC deny in place, audit verbose enabled. Next: rotate partner signing key (out-of-band), rebuild and issue new short-lived creds to partner, and run automated scanner to detect long-lived lease renewals.

ajay: I'll schedule the partner key rotation with infra and add a pre- and post-checklist (rekey, rewrap check, consumer smoke tests).

kevin: Can we add a quick script to auto-revoke leases that renew beyond TTL? I can prototype.

taylor: Add that to the postmortem action items and make it a gating check for partner onboarding.

sec-bot: Incident #incident-kms-lease-2026-04-17 severity: high -> mitigated. PagerDuty incident set to resolved-on-hold for postmortem.

sarah: Postmortem scheduled for Thu 10am PT. Owners: kevin (revocation automation), ajay (KMS rewrap automation), taylor (RBAC policy hardening). I'll draft communications to the partner legal/security teams. Thanks team — please drop any residual logs or artifacts in #eng-security for the writeup. :thumbsup:

kevin: Dropped revoke audit export: s3://redwood-audit/exports/revoke-2026-04-17.json

ajay: Added rewrap runbook to repo: https://git.redwood/repo/runbooks/kms-rewrap.md

taylor: Terraform PR merged for temporary deny; follow-up will be to replace with least-privilege role binding after partner key rotation.

sarah: Closing thread — moving to postmortem. If anyone sees lingering decrypt errors ping me directly.
